about: Archer line (Archer 3100, Hunter 3200, Sniper 3300, Ranger 3400): skill mechanics SkillConfig does not carry, read from each skill's own description and timeline (SkillMechanics.cs documents every field). The original server scripts are not in the client, so every entry is inferred; 'why' quotes the evidence. Entries are keyed by _iSkillID and therefore apply to every _iMode of the group; mode differences are noted per entry. Blitz Beat and Sharp Shooting are _iRangeType 1, whose target selection currently returns only the locked enemy before consulting these entries (see the archer findings).

group:13301.name: Fear Breeze -> piercing arrows
group:13301.why: Fear Breeze 13303: 'While the effect lasts, when a targeted bow skill hits, the target has a «30»% Chance to be struck by piercing arrows, taking «3» hits of Neutral ranged Physical damage totaling Physical ATK*«50»%'; buff 1330101-1330105 _kLogicData [3000] = 30% and row group 13304 (P1 5000, _kShowDmg [3]) is that strike, at the learned Fear Breeze level. Any damaging hit of the holder counts (inferred: the server cannot tell a bow skill from others here).

13330.name: Warg Hunt (Ranged)
13330.why: The far branch of Warg Hunt ('more than «5»m from the target, you also dash in front of it'): show 13330 carries the displacement 1333014, so the rider dashes to 1 m in front of the target (inferred stop) before its hits (_kShowDmg [3], mode 1 [5]).

13312:1.name: Warg Strike (mounted Warg Charge)
13312:1.why: Mode 1 (needs riding the wolf 1500400; selected by its Mount Buff 1331001 type 15): 'Commands the Demonic Wolf to Charge the designated ST target within «15» meters'; show 13312 carries the displacement 1331203 (94 ms), so the ridden wolf rushes to 1 m in front of the target (inferred stop) before the hit. Swift Warg 13326: 'Casting [Warg Charge] or [Warg Hunt] resets this skill's Cooldown'.

13320:1.name: Myriad Stars Chase the Moon (talent mode 1)
13320:1.why: Mode-1 rows 1332011-1332015: 'continuously dealing PATK * «1600..2000»%' = 10 x _kDamageParam1[0] (160..200%); template 133201 has 12 attack points (launch at 0, then 0.5-2.5 s): ten hits at points 1-10 on the 18 x 4 m strip from where the arrow was fired. The group entry's 7 hits under-hit this mode.

13305.name: Focused Arrow Strike
13305.why: '... dealing PATK * «56»% ... to the target and up to «5» enemies in a line within Attack Range' (range «18» m): the same piercing line as Sharp Shooting (13204, _kLogicData [3, 150]: 1.5 m wide, inferred for this family), 18 m from the caster toward the locked target, 1 + 5 targets (_iTargetMax is 1).

13325.name: Warg Bite
13325.why: 'Commands the Demonic Wolf to bite the designated ST target ... dealing Physical ATK*«150»% ... and resetting the Cooldown of [Warg Hunt]': ends group 13323's cooldown.

13323.name: Warg Hunt
13323.why: 'Commands «3» wolf followers to attack the designated ST target ... dealing «3» hits ... totaling Physical ATK*«110»%. If you are more than «5»m from the target, you also dash in front of it': the cast's own show 13323 is only the rider's animation. Its _kLogicData names the near row (13329 Warg Hunt (Melee)) and the far row (13330 Warg Hunt (Ranged)); their shows hold the three wolves (fx_skill_wughunt_01 x3), the hits and, for the far one, the dash (1333014). So the cast deals nothing itself and releases the near or far row by the distance (mode 1 rows carry the enhanced «5»-hit pair). Swift Warg 13326: 'Casting [Warg Charge] or [Warg Hunt] resets this skill's Cooldown'.

13003.name: Double Strafe
13003.why: 'Fires 2 Arrows simultaneously, dealing «2» hits of PATK * «100»% + «75» Neutral Ranged Physical DMG': the value is per hit (no 'totaling'), _kDamageParam1 10000 / _kDamageParam2 75 is one hit (lv1 '«2» hits of PATK * «55»% + «66»' = P1 5500, P2 66), so the cast deals two rolls of 100% + 75. The template has a single attack point (0.17 s) and the arrows fly together, so both hits land at point 0, each shown as one number.

13102.name: Blitz Beat
13102.why: 'dealing PATK * «100»% + «100» ... to the designated ST enemy within «18» meters and up to «2» Other enemies within «3» meters of the target': a 3 m splash around the locked target, 1 + 2 = _iTargetMax 3; _kLogicData [300, 3, 0] carries the same 3 m / 3 targets. Mode 1 (talent) is '«3» Other enemies within «4» meters' (_kLogicData [400, 4, ...], _iTargetMax 4): the radius stays 3 m until mechanics can be keyed per mode.

13110.name: Blitz Beat (auto-cast)
13110.why: 'dealing PATK * «5»% + «5» ... to the designated ST enemy within «18» meters and up to «2» Other enemies within «3» meters of the target': same 3 m splash around the locked target as 13102, _iTargetMax 3, _kLogicData [300, 3, 0]. Mode 1 is 4 m / 1 + 3 (see 13102).

13204.name: Sharp Shooting
13204.why: 'dealing PATK * «55»% + «55» ... to the target and up to «3» enemies in a line within Attack Range' (range «18» m): a piercing line from the caster toward the locked target (the cast faces it), 18 m long; _kLogicData [3, 150] = 3 extra targets and (inferred) a 1.5 m line width; 1 + 3 targets (_iTargetMax is 1).

13320.name: Myriad Stars Chase the Moon
13320.why: 'Fires a hurricane Arrow in the designated direction across a «18»-meter by «4»-meter area, continuously dealing PATK * «1400»% ... to up to «10» enemies in its path': _kDamageParam1 20000 (200%, shown in 2, _kShowDmg [2]) at each of the seven attack points after the launch (0.5-1.7 s) = 1400% (lv1 7 x 160 = «1120», lv3 7 x 180 = «1260»). The strip is 18 x 4 m per the description (kRange says 1800 x 600) and lies from where the shot was fired: the caster may walk during the cast ('MSPD increases by «30»%'). Mode 1 (talent, 12 attack points, '«2000»%' = 10 x 200%) still gets 7 hits here until mechanics can be keyed per mode.

13327.name: Warg Companion (Warg Strike)
13327.why: King of the Wargs (13322): 'casting [Warg Charge] causes «4» wolf followers to charge alongside you, dealing «4» Extra hits ... totaling Physical ATK*«320»%': this row's _kDamageParam1 8000 is one follower (80%), and its template has four attack points (0.75, 0.92, 1.08, 1.25 s), 4 x 80% = 320% (lv1 4 x 72% = «288», lv3 4 x 76% = «304»). Mode 1 (Rhythmic, 5 attack points, 120%) has no description and keeps four hits here.
